Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the 2003 (Figure 1) and 2007 (Figure 2) radiographs reveals increased pleural thickening and apical opacity in the left upper zone. In a patient with chronic sarcoidosis and established fibrocystic disease, this progression is highly suggestive of a superimposed aspergilloma (mycetoma) forming within a pre-existing cavity.
